top_signal.title: Small team, more work than we can handle. How do you hire the first employee well?
top_signal.summary: My co-founder and I have run Luxeia for a while, and the growth is outpacing us. We want our first hires to be people who care as much as we do. We’ve launched a crowdfunder to help pay for it. My biggest worry right now is the aftercare. When we are on-site delivering a project the client is receiving 100% of our time and energy, but after that the next project rolls in and we become stretched on the aftercare. Any advice on that first hire is welcome.    https://www.crowdfunder.co.uk/p/luxeia-smart-homes        submitted by     /u/LuxeiaSmartHomes       [link]       [comments]
